en.s: The Battle of Maeso (Hangul: 매소성 전투; hanja: 買肖城戰鬪) was a battle between Silla and Tang forces in the Korean peninsula.On September 29, 675, a confrontation occurred between a Silla of 30,000 under the command of Kim Wonsul and a Tang of 200,000 troops under Li Jinxing. Silla killed 6,047 cavalry of Tang and got 30,380 horses and weapons of about 30,000.

zh.s: 买肖城战役是新罗与唐军在朝鲜半岛进行的一场战斗。675年9月29日，金元述率领3万新罗军，与李谨行率领的20万唐军交战。新罗军击杀唐军6047名骑兵，并缴获约30,380匹马和武器。

en.s: The siege of Canterbury was a major Viking raid on the city of Canterbury that occurred between 8 and 29 September 1011, fought between a Viking army led by Thorkell the Tall and the Anglo-Saxon defenders. The details of the siege are largely unknown, and most of the known events were recorded in the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle.

zh.s: 1011年9月8日至29日，托克尔·长者率领的维京军队围攻坎特伯雷，与盎格鲁-撒克逊守军交战。围城的具体情况大多已不可考，已知信息主要来自《盎格鲁-撒克逊编年史》。

en.s: The siege of Xerigordos in 1096 (often Xerigordon in modern historical literature) pitted 6,000 Germans of the People's Crusade under Rainald of Broyes against the Turks commanded by Elchanes, general of Kilij Arslan, the Seljuk Sultan of Rûm. The Crusader raiding party captured the Turkish fort of Xerigordos, about four days' march from Nicaea, in an attempt to set up a pillaging outpost.

zh.s: 1096年，雷纳尔德·德·布瓦率领人民十字军中的6000名德意志士兵，与鲁姆塞尔柱苏丹克勒奇·阿尔斯兰麾下将领埃尔哈内斯指挥的土耳其军队交战。十字军突袭部队攻占了塞里戈多斯的土耳其堡垒，试图在那里建立一处掠夺据点。堡垒距尼西亚约四天路程。

en.t: Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor, is excommunicated by Pope Gregory IX for his failure to participate in the Crusades during the Investiture Controversy
en.s: Frederick II (Italian: Federico, Sicilian: Fidiricu, German: Friedrich, Latin: Fridericus; 26 December 1194 – 13 December 1250) was King of Sicily from 1198, King of Germany from 1212, King of Italy and Holy Roman Emperor from 1220, and King of Jerusalem from 1225 to 1228. He was the son of Emperor Henry VI, of the Hohenstaufen dynasty (the second son of Emperor Frederick Barbarossa), and Queen Constance I of Sicily, of the Hauteville dynasty.

zh.t: 教宗额我略九世因腓特烈二世未参加十字军东征而将其绝罚
zh.s: 腓特烈二世（意大利语：Federico；西西里语：Fidiricu；德语：Friedrich；拉丁语：Fridericus；1194年12月26日—1250年12月13日）自1198年起为西西里国王，1212年起为德意志国王，1220年起为意大利国王和神圣罗马皇帝，并于1225年至1228年间为耶路撒冷国王。他是皇帝亨利六世与西西里女王康斯坦丝一世之子，出身霍亨斯陶芬王朝；亨利六世是皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的次子，康斯坦丝则出身奥特维尔王朝。

en.s: The Treaty of Montgomery was an Anglo-Welsh treaty signed on 29 September 1267 in Montgomeryshire by which Llywelyn ap Gruffudd was acknowledged as Prince of Wales by King Henry III of England (r. 1216–1272). It was the only time an English ruler recognised the right of a ruler of Gwynedd over Wales.

zh.s: 蒙哥马利条约是英格兰与威尔士于1267年9月29日在蒙哥马利郡签署的一项条约。英格兰国王亨利三世（1216—1272年在位）承认卢埃林·阿普·格鲁菲兹为威尔士亲王。这是英格兰君主唯一一次承认格温内斯统治者拥有对整个威尔士的统治权。

en.s: The Battle of Auray (29 September 1364) at the Breton-French town of Auray was the decisive confrontation of the Breton War of Succession, a part of the Hundred Years' War. In the battle, which began as a siege, a Breton army, led by Duke John de Montfort, assisted by English forces commanded by John Chandos, opposed a Breton army led by his rival Charles of Blois and assisted by French forces led by Bertrand du Guesclin.

zh.s: 欧赖战役于1364年9月29日在法国布列塔尼的欧赖镇爆发，是布列塔尼继承战争的决战，也是百年战争的一部分。战斗最初以围城形式展开。约翰·德·蒙福尔公爵率领布列塔尼军队，在约翰·钱多斯指挥的英军支援下，对阵布卢瓦的夏尔率领的另一支布列塔尼军队；后者得到贝特朗·迪·盖克兰指挥的法军支援。

en.t: During the French War of Religion, Protestant coup officials in Nîmes massacre Catholic priests in an event now known as the Michelade
en.s: The French Wars of Religion (French: Guerres de Religion en France) were a series of civil wars between French Catholics and Protestants (called Huguenots) from 1562 to 1598. Between two and four million people died from violence, famine or disease directly caused by the conflict, and it severely damaged the power of the French monarchy.

zh.t: 法国宗教战争期间，尼姆新教政变者屠杀天主教神父，史称“米歇拉德事件”
zh.s: 法国宗教战争（法语：Guerres de Religion en France）是1562年至1598年间法国天主教徒与新教徒（胡格诺派）之间的一系列内战。冲突直接导致200万至400万人死于暴力、饥荒或疾病，并严重削弱了法国君主制的权力。

en.s: The Battle of Arques occurred on 15–29 September 1589 between the French royal forces of King Henry IV of France and troops of the Catholic League commanded by Charles of Lorraine, Duke of Mayenne, during the eighth and final war (1585–1598) of the French Wars of Religion. It was a victory for Henry IV.

zh.s: 1589年9月15日至29日，法王亨利四世的王室军队与洛林公爵马耶纳的夏尔指挥的天主教联盟军队交战。这是法国宗教战争第八次、也是最后一次战争中的一场战斗。亨利四世获胜。

en.s: The siege of Smolensk (Polish: oblężenie Smoleńska), also known as the Smolensk Defense in Russia (Russian: Смоленская оборона), lasted 20 months between 29 September 1609 to 13 June 1611, when the Polish army besieged the Russian city of Smolensk during the Polish–Russian War of 1609–1618.

zh.s: 斯摩棱斯克围城战也称斯摩棱斯克防御战，波兰语称“斯摩棱斯克围城”，俄语称“斯摩棱斯克防御”。波兰军队于1609年9月29日至1611年6月13日围攻俄罗斯城市斯摩棱斯克，历时20个月。这场围城发生在1609年至1618年的波俄战争期间。

en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

en.s: The Capture of St. Michael (Danish; Kapre af St. Michael) or the Seizure of St. Michael, was a Danish seizure of a Bengali ship in the Bay of Bengal. The Danes captured the Bengali ship and the vessel was subsequently incorporated into the Danish Navy given the name St. Michael.

zh.s: 丹麦人在孟加拉湾扣押了一艘孟加拉船只，这艘船后来被编入丹麦海军，并命名为“圣米迦勒”号。

en.s: The battle of Gródek Jagielloński or battle of Horodok took place during the Russo-Polish War (1654–67) on 29 September 1655. Russian and Ukrainian Cossack forces under Vasily Borisovich Sheremetev and Bohdan Khmelnytsky engaged a Polish–Lithuanian army under Stanisław "Rewera" Potocki near Gródek Jagielloński, which at that time was part of Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth's Ruthenian Voivodeship (now Horodok, Lviv Oblast, Ukraine).

zh.s: 霍罗多克战役也称格鲁德克亚盖隆斯基战役，发生于1655年9月29日，是俄波战争（1654—1667年）中的一场战斗。瓦西里·鲍里索维奇·舍列梅捷夫和博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基率领俄军与乌克兰哥萨克部队，在格鲁德克亚盖隆斯基附近同斯坦尼斯瓦夫·“雷韦拉”·波托茨基指挥的波兰—立陶宛军队交战。当时该地属于波兰—立陶宛联邦的鲁塞尼亚省，如今是乌克兰利沃夫州霍罗多克。

en.s: The siege of the Acropolis took place on 23–29 September 1687, as the Venetian forces under Francesco Morosini and Otto Wilhelm Königsmarck laid siege to the Acropolis of Athens, held by the Ottoman garrison of the city. The siege resulted in the destruction of a large part of the Parthenon, which the Ottomans used as a gunpowder store.

zh.s: 1687年9月23日至29日，弗朗切斯科·莫罗西尼和奥托·威廉·柯尼希斯马克率领威尼斯军队围攻由奥斯曼守军控制的雅典卫城。围城导致帕特农神庙大部分被毁；奥斯曼军队当时将神庙用作火药库。

en.t: An earthquake strikes Antigua Guatemala, destroying much of the city's architecture
en.s: Antigua Guatemala (Spanish pronunciation: [anˈtiɣwa ɣwateˈmala]), commonly known as Antigua or La Antigua, is a city in the central highlands of Guatemala. The city was the capital of the Captaincy General of Guatemala from 1543 through 1773, with much of its Baroque-influenced architecture and layout dating from that period. Antigua Guatemala serves as the capital of the homonymous municipality and the Sacatepéquez Department.

zh.t: 地震袭击危地马拉安提瓜，摧毁城中大部分建筑
zh.s: 危地马拉安提瓜（西班牙语读音：[anˈtiɣwa ɣwateˈmala]），常称安提瓜或拉安提瓜，是危地马拉中部高地的一座城市。1543年至1773年间，该城是危地马拉都督府首府，许多受巴洛克风格影响的建筑和城市布局都建于这一时期。危地马拉安提瓜也是同名市镇和萨卡特佩克斯省的首府。

en.t: J. S. Bach leads the first performance of Herr Gott, dich loben alle wir, BWV 130 for the feast of archangel Michael, based on Paul Eber's hymn in twelve stanzas
en.s: Herr Gott, dich loben alle wir (Lord God, we all praise you), BWV 130, is a chorale cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach for the Feast of archangel Michael (German: Michaelis; 29 September). It is based on Paul Eber's 1554 Lutheran hymn about the angels in twelve stanzas "Herr Gott, dich loben alle wir", to a melody known in English as Old 100th.

zh.t: 巴赫首次演出《主啊，上帝，我们都赞美你》，BWV 130
zh.s: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫为圣米迦勒节创作了圣咏清唱剧《主啊，上帝，我们都赞美你》（BWV 130），并于9月29日首次演出。作品以保罗·埃伯1554年创作的同名路德宗赞美诗为基础，共十二节；其旋律在英语中也称为“旧百篇”。

en.s: The Battle of Kvistrum (also known as the Battle of Kvistrum Bridge) was fought on 29 September 1788 during the Theatre War, a phase of the Russo-Swedish War of 1788–1790, between Sweden and the Denmark–Norway. The Swedes lost the battle and had five killed and the rest captured with 60 wounded, the Danes and Norwegians had suffered 5 killed and 16 wounded.

zh.s: 克维斯特鲁姆战役也称克维斯特鲁姆桥战役，于1788年9月29日爆发，是剧场战争中的一场战斗，属于1788年至1790年的俄瑞战争。交战双方是瑞典与丹麦—挪威。瑞典战败，5人阵亡、60人受伤，其余人员被俘；丹麦—挪威方面5人阵亡、16人受伤。

en.t: The United States Department of War first establishes a regular army with a strength of several hundred men
en.s: The United States Department of War, also called the War Department (and occasionally War Office in the early years), was the United States Cabinet department responsible for the operation and maintenance of the United States Army. It also had responsibility for naval affairs from 1794 until the establishment of the Department of the Navy in 1798, and for most non-naval air forces until the creation of the Department of the Air Force on September 18, 1947.

zh.t: 美国战争部首次建立一支数百人的常备军
zh.s: 美国战争部也称陆军部，在早期偶尔称为战争办公室，是美国内阁部门，负责美国陆军的运作和维护。1794年至1798年海军部成立前，该部门也负责海军事务；在1947年9月18日空军部成立前，还负责大部分非海军航空部队。

en.s: The Battle of Łabiszyn took place during the Kościuszko Uprising, on the night of 28 and 29 September 1794, between Polish–Lithuanian insurgents commanded by General Jan Henryk Dąbrowski and Prussian troops commanded by Colonel Johann Friedrich Székely, ending in victory for the Poles. It was fought on a hill near Łabiszyn, in South Prussia, Kingdom of Prussia (now part of Poland).

zh.s: 拉比申战役发生于科希丘什科起义期间。1794年9月28日至29日夜间，扬·亨利克·东布罗夫斯基将军率领的波兰—立陶宛起义军与约翰·弗里德里希·谢凯利上校指挥的普鲁士军队交战，波兰军队获胜。战斗在普鲁士王国南普鲁士、拉比申附近的一座山上进行，该地如今属于波兰。

en.s: The Combat of Rosslau was fought in the War of the Sixth Coalition on 29 September 1813, near Rosslau, Germany. Michel Ney attacked the Swedish bridgehead at the Elbe, to stop the Army of the North from crossing the river. The Swedish commander Johan August Sandels counterattacked and chased the French for 5 km (3 mi) before being forced to retire himself.

zh.s: 第六次反法同盟战争期间，1813年9月29日，法军与瑞典军队在德国罗斯劳附近交战。米歇尔·内伊率军进攻易北河上的瑞典桥头堡，试图阻止北方军团渡河。瑞典指挥官约翰·奥古斯特·桑德尔斯随后反击，将法军驱退5公里，之后自己也被迫撤退。

en.s: The Najd Expedition (Turkish: Nejd Seferi) was a multi-battle campaign waged by Ottoman Egypt from 1817 to 1818. It was part of Third Campaign of the Ottoman–Wahhabi War of 1811 to 1818, which was the final campaign on the war. It was commanded by Ibrahim Pasha, son of Egyptian ruler Muhammad Ali Pasha, by order of Ottoman Sultan Mahmud II.

en.t: The Metropolitan Police of London, later also known as the Met, is founded
en.s: The Metropolitan Police Service (MPS), commonly known as the Metropolitan Police, Met Police, or the "Met", is the territorial police force responsible for law enforcement and crime prevention within Greater London. In addition, it is responsible for specialised tasks throughout the United Kingdom, such as dealing with counter-terrorism throughout the UK, and the protection of certain individuals, including the monarch, royal family, governmental officials, and other designated figures.

zh.t: 伦敦警察厅成立，后来也称为“大都会警察”
zh.s: 伦敦警察厅（MPS）通常称为大都会警察或“Met”，负责大伦敦地区的执法和犯罪预防。此外，该机构还在英国全国范围内承担专门任务，例如反恐，以及保护君主、王室成员、政府官员和其他指定人士。

en.s: The First Carlist War was a civil war in Spain from 1833 to 1840, the first of three Carlist Wars. It was fought between two factions over the succession to the throne and the nature of the Spanish monarchy: the conservative and devolutionist supporters of the late king's brother, Carlos de Borbón (or Carlos V), became known as Carlists (carlistas), while the progressive and centralist supporters of the regent, Maria Christina, acting for Isabella II of Spain, were called Liberals (liberales), cristinos or isabelinos.

zh.s: 第一次卡洛斯战争是1833至1840年西班牙的一场内战，也是三次卡洛斯战争中的第一次。双方围绕王位继承和西班牙君主制的性质交战：已故国王之弟卡洛斯·德·波旁（卡洛斯五世）的保守派、地方分权支持者被称为卡洛斯派；摄政王玛丽亚·克里斯蒂娜代表伊莎贝拉二世执政，其进步派和中央集权支持者则称自由派，也称克里斯蒂诺派或伊莎贝拉派。

en.s: The Battle of Pákozd (or Battle of Sukoró) was a battle in the Hungarian war of Independence of 1848–1849, fought on the 29 September 1848 in the Pákozd – Sukoró – Pátka triangle. It was the first and one of the most important major battles of the war of independence, in which the Hungarian revolutionary army led by Lieutenant-General János Móga stopped the troops of the Croatian Ban Josip Jelačić, who, in accordance with the Habsburg plans, was marching towards Pest to occupy it and chase out the Hungarian national government.

zh.s: 帕科兹战役也称舒科罗战役，发生于1848年9月29日，是1848年至1849年匈牙利独立战争中的一场战斗。战场位于帕科兹、舒科罗和帕特卡三地之间。这是独立战争中的首场重要战役之一。莫高·亚诺什中将率领的匈牙利革命军挡住了克罗地亚总督约瑟普·耶拉契奇的部队。后者遵照哈布斯堡王朝的计划向佩斯进军，准备占领该城并驱逐匈牙利民族政府。

en.s: The Battle of Tysami was a military engagement involving a warship from the British China Squadron and the Chinese pirates of Chui A-poo. It was fought in September 1849 off Tysami, Harlaim Bay, China, and ended with a Royal Navy victory. It was also the precursor engagement to the larger Battle of Pinghoi Creek where Chui A-poo's fleet was destroyed.

en.s: The Battle of Ahualulco took place on 29 September 1858 during the War of Reform, near the town of Ahualulco in the state of San Luis Potosi, Mexico, between elements of the liberal army, commanded by the generals Santiago Vidaurri, Juan Zuazua and Francisco Naranjo and conservative army troops commanded by General Miguel Miramon and Leonardo Márquez. zh.s: 改革战争期间，1858年9月29日，自由派军队与保守派军队在墨西哥圣路易斯波托西州阿瓦卢尔科镇附近交战。自由派由圣地亚哥·维达乌里、胡安·苏阿苏亚和弗朗西斯科·纳兰霍将军指挥；保守派由米格尔·米拉蒙和莱昂纳多·马尔克斯将军指挥。保守派获胜，造成自由派672人伤亡、91人被俘。这是米拉蒙最辉煌的胜利之一。

en.s: The Siege of Ancona took place between 24 and 29 September 1860 during the Piedmontese campaign in central Italy. Following their defeat at the Battle of Castelfidardo, the remnants of the Papal States army under General Louis Juchault de Lamoricière retreated into the port city of Ancona. The city was blockaded by the Royal Sardinian Navy and surrounded on land by the Royal Sardinian Army commanded by General Manfredo Fanti.

zh.s: 安科纳围城战于1860年9月24日至29日进行，是皮埃蒙特军队在意大利中部发动的战役之一。教皇国军队在卡斯泰尔菲达尔多战役中战败后，残部在路易·朱绍·德·拉莫里西埃将军率领下撤入港口城市安科纳。萨丁王国海军封锁了港口，曼弗雷多·范蒂将军指挥的萨丁王国陆军则从陆地包围该城。

en.s: The Treaty of Lisbon is a treaty on the borders of Spain and Portugal from the mouth of the Minho River to the junction of the Caia River with the Guadiana River. Signed in Lisbon on 29 September 1864, it abolished the Couto Misto microstate. The final act of approving annexes to the treaty was signed at Lisbon on 4 November 1866.

en.t: The first practical public electric tramway in the world is opened in Blackpool, England
en.s: The Blackpool Tramway runs from Blackpool to Fleetwood on The Fylde in Lancashire, England. The line dates back to 1885 and is one of the oldest electric tramways in the world. It is operated by Blackpool Transport Services (BTS) and runs for 18 km (11 miles). It carried 4.4 million passengers in 2024/25.

zh.t: 世界首条实用公共电车线路在英格兰布莱克浦开通
zh.s: 布莱克浦有轨电车线路从兰开夏郡菲尔德半岛上的布莱克浦通往弗利特伍德。线路始建于1885年，是世界上历史最悠久的电气化有轨电车线路之一。该线路由布莱克浦交通服务公司运营，全长18公里（11英里），在2024/25年度运送了440万名乘客。

en.s: A tram (also known as a tramcar, or a streetcar or trolley in the United States and Canada) is an urban rail transit type in which vehicles, whether individual railcars or multiple-unit trains, run on tramway tracks laid on public streets, although some trams run on sections of track in their own segregated right-of-way. Trams are a type of light rail and are included within this broader category.

zh.s: 有轨电车又称电车；在美国和加拿大也称街车或无轨电车，是一种城市轨道交通工具。车辆可以是单节车厢或多节编组列车，通常在铺设于公共街道的轨道上运行，也有些电车使用与道路隔离的专用轨道。有轨电车属于轻轨交通。

en.s: The battle of El Espinillo was a naval engagement between warships of the Argentine Navy that took place during an insurrection on 29 September 1893 on the Paraná River, along El Espinillo Island, Entre Ríos, on the opposite bank from the city of Rosario, Santa Fe. The action was the result of a rebellion against the National Government led by the Radical Civic Union (UCR) party, known as the Argentine Revolution of 1893.

zh.s: 埃尔埃斯皮尼约海战是阿根廷海军军舰之间的一场海战，于1893年9月29日在帕拉纳河上、埃尔埃斯皮尼约岛沿岸爆发，河对岸是圣菲省罗萨里奥市。这场战斗发生于一场起义期间。激进公民联盟（UCR）领导的叛乱反对国家政府，是1893年阿根廷革命的一部分。

en.s: Battle of Shinanah was a major battle of the Saudi–Rashidi War, during the Unification of Saudi Arabia campaign, between Rashidi and Saudi rebels. It occurred on 29 September 1904, in town of Shinanah in Qassim region. After Ibn Saud victory in Battle of Bekeriyah, Ibn Saud planned to conquer the whole Qassim region. Ibn Rashid also planned to regain control on the region. The battle ended with Saudi victory, Ibn Saud gained thousands of the remains Turkish supplies in the town, Ibn Rashid and his Ottoman allies forced to move back to Rawdat Muhanna.

zh.s: 希纳纳战役是沙特统一战争期间沙特—拉希德战争中的一场重要战役，于1904年9月29日在卡西姆地区的希纳纳镇爆发，交战双方是拉希德军队和沙特起义军。沙特军队在贝克里耶战役获胜后，伊本·沙特计划征服整个卡西姆地区，伊本·拉希德则希望夺回控制权。战斗以沙特获胜告终；伊本·沙特缴获了当地大量土耳其军队遗留的物资，伊本·拉希德及其奥斯曼盟友则被迫撤往拉乌达特穆汉纳。

en.s: The Provisional Government of Cuba (Spanish: Gobierno Provisional de Cuba) lasted from September 1906 to February 1909. This period was also referred to as the Second occupation of Cuba. When the government of Cuban President Tomás Estrada Palma collapsed, U.S. President Theodore Roosevelt ordered U.S. military forces into Cuba. Their mission was to prevent fighting between the Cubans, to protect U.S. economic interests there, and to hold free elections in order to establish a new and legitimate government.

zh.t: 塔夫脱在1906年9月29日美国临时政府成立后立即采取行动
zh.s: 古巴临时政府（西班牙语：Gobierno Provisional de Cuba）存在于1906年9月至1909年2月，这一时期也称美国第二次占领古巴。古巴总统托马斯·埃斯特拉达·帕尔马政府垮台后，美国总统西奥多·罗斯福下令美军进入古巴，以阻止古巴人之间发生战斗、保护美国在当地的经济利益，并举行自由选举以建立新政府。

en.s: The 1907 Tie Cup final was the final match to decide the winner of the Tie Cup, the 8th edition of the international competition organised by the Argentine and Uruguayan Associations together. The final was contested by Argentine Alumni and Uruguayan CURCC. In the final, played at Ferro Carril Oeste Stadium in Caballito, Buenos Aires with a full attendance of 7,000, Alumni beat CURCC 3–1, with goals by Alfredo Brown (2) and Eliseo Brown.

zh.s: 1907年Tie杯决赛是该项赛事的冠军决胜场，也是阿根廷和乌拉圭足协联合主办的第8届国际赛事。决赛由阿根廷阿尔米兰特队对阵乌拉圭中央铁路俱乐部队，在布宜诺斯艾利斯卡瓦利托区的西部铁路球场举行，现场观众满座，共7000人。阿尔米兰特以3比1获胜，阿尔弗雷多·布朗打入两球，埃利塞奥·布朗攻入一球。

en.s: The Italo-Turkish or Turco-Italian War (Turkish: Trablusgarp Savaşı, "Tripolitanian War"; also known in Italy as Guerra di Libia, "Libyan War") was fought between the Ottoman Empire (Turkey) and the Kingdom of Italy from September 29, 1911, to October 18, 1912. As a result of this conflict, Italy captured the Ottoman Tripolitania Vilayet (province), of which the main sub-provinces (sanjaks) were Fezzan, Cyrenaica, and Tripoli itself. These territories together formed what became known as Italian Libya. During the conflict, Italian forces also occupied the Dodecanese islands in the Aegean Sea.

zh.s: 意土战争也称土意战争、的黎波里战争或利比亚战争，是奥斯曼帝国（今土耳其）与意大利王国之间的战争，于1911年9月29日至1912年10月18日进行。战争期间，意大利攻占了奥斯曼帝国的的黎波里塔尼亚省，包括费赞、昔兰尼加和的黎波里等主要地区。这些领土后来组成意属利比亚。意军还占领了爱琴海的多德卡尼斯群岛。

en.s: The Italian invasion of Libya occurred in 1911, when Italian troops invaded the Ottoman province of Libya (then part of the Ottoman Empire) and started the Italo-Turkish War. It was the decisive engagement during the Battle of Transylvania, and also the largest, involving four armies out of the five fighting in the region: two Romanian, one German, and one Austro-Hungarian.

en.s: Elections were held in the state of Western Australia on 29 September 1917 to elect 50 members to the Western Australian Legislative Assembly. The Nationalist-Country-National Labor coalition, led by Premier Sir Henry Lefroy, retained government against the Labor Party led by Opposition Leader Philip Collier. The election followed a series of major changes in the Western Australian political landscape.

zh.s: 西澳大利亚州于1917年9月29日举行选举，选出立法议会50名议员。亨利·勒弗罗伊爵士领导的国民党—乡村党—国家工党联合政府击败菲利普·科利尔领导的反对党工党，成功连任执政。选举前，西澳大利亚州政坛经历了一系列重大变化。

en.s: The Battle of St Quentin Canal was a pivotal battle of World War I that began on 29 September 1918 and involved British, Australian and American forces operating as part of the British Fourth Army under the overall command of General Sir Henry Rawlinson. Further north, part of the British Third Army also supported the attack.

zh.s: 圣康坦运河战役是第一次世界大战中的关键战役，于1918年9月29日打响。英国、澳大利亚和美国部队作为亨利·罗林森将军指挥的英国第四集团军的一部分参战。更北面的英国第三集团军部分部队也支援了进攻。

en.s: The Vardar offensive (Bulgarian: Офанзива при Вардар) was a World War I military operation, fought between 15 and 29 September 1918. The operation took place during the final stage of the Balkan Front. On 15 September, a combined force of Serbian, French, and Greek troops attacked the Bulgarian-held trenches in Dobro Pole ("Good Field"), at the time part of the Bulgarian-occupied Kingdom of Serbia and the Kingdom of Greece (present-day North Macedonia and Greece).

zh.s: 瓦尔达尔攻势是第一次世界大战期间的一场军事行动，于1918年9月15日至29日进行，是巴尔干战线最后阶段的战役之一。9月15日，塞尔维亚、法国和希腊联军进攻多布罗波列（意为“良田”）的保加利亚军队战壕。当时该地属于保加利亚占领下的塞尔维亚王国和希腊王国，如今位于北马其顿和希腊境内。

en.t: World War I: Germany's Supreme Army Command tells Kaiser Wilhelm II and Imperial Chancellor Georg Michaelis to open negotiations for an armistice to end the war
en.s: Georg Michaelis (8 September 1857 – 24 July 1936) was the imperial chancellor of the German Empire for a few months in 1917 during the First World War. en.t: World War I: Bulgaria signs the Armistice of Salonica ending its participation
en.s: The Armistice of Salonica (also known as the Armistice of Thessalonica) was the armistice signed at 10:50 p.m. on 29 September 1918 between Bulgaria and the Allied Powers at the General Headquarters of the Allied Army of the Orient in Thessaloniki. The armistice came into force at noon on 30 September 1918. The armistice would remain in effect until the conclusion of the Treaty of Neuilly-sur-Seine, the final general peace treaty, in November 1919.

zh.s: 保加利亚与协约国于1918年9月29日晚10时50分在协约国东方军总司令部所在地塞萨洛尼基签署停战协定，结束保加利亚的战争行动。协定于1918年9月30日中午生效，并持续有效至1919年11月《讷伊条约》签署为止。

en.s: The Battle of Sarıkamış was a conflict between the First Republic of Armenia and the Eastern Front of the Army of the Grand National Assembly of Turkey which was on September 29, 1920, at Sarıkamış. After the Sarikamish war signed the Armistice of Mudros, the Turks launched an invasion of Armenia, keeping the Armenians away from the Sarikamis front.

zh.s: 萨勒卡默什战役是亚美尼亚第一共和国与土耳其大国民议会军队东线部队之间的冲突，于1920年9月29日在萨勒卡默什发生。穆德罗斯停战协定签署后，土耳其人发动对亚美尼亚的入侵，使亚美尼亚人远离萨勒卡默什战线。

en.t: The First American Track and Field championships for women are held
en.s: The 1923 USA Outdoor Track and Field Championships were organized by the Amateur Athletic Union (AAU) and served as the national championships in outdoor track and field for the United States. The year marked the first ever women's U.S. track and field championships. The men's edition was held at Stagg Field in Chicago, Illinois, and it took place September 1.

en.t: The Mandate for Palestine came into effect, officially creating the protectorates of Mandatory Palestine under British administration and Transjordan as a separate emirate under King Abdullah I
en.s: The Mandate for Palestine was a League of Nations mandate for British administration of the territories of Palestine and Transjordan – which had been part of the Ottoman Empire for four centuries – following the defeat of the Ottoman Empire in World War I. Under the mandate, Britain assumed obligations both to the inhabitants of Palestine and to the establishment of a Jewish national home, as set out in the British government's 1917 Balfour Declaration.

zh.t: 巴勒斯坦托管地委任统治生效，正式设立英国管辖的巴勒斯坦托管地和阿卜杜拉一世统治下的外约旦酋长国
zh.s: 巴勒斯坦托管地是国际联盟授权英国管理巴勒斯坦和外约旦领土的委任统治地；这些地区曾属于奥斯曼帝国长达四个世纪，奥斯曼帝国在第一次世界大战中战败后交由英国管理。根据委任统治条款，英国既须对巴勒斯坦居民承担义务，也须推动建立犹太人的民族家园，依据是英国政府1917年的《贝尔福宣言》。

en.t: 1925 United States Senate special election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1925 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on September 29, 1925, to complete the unexpired term of U.S. Senator Robert La Follette, who died on June 18. The seat was won by La Follette's son and personal secretary, Robert M. La Follette Jr. over mostly Republican opposition. en.s: The Raglan by-election of 1927 was a by-election held in the Raglan electorate during the 22nd New Zealand Parliament, on 29 September 1927. It was caused by the death of incumbent MP Richard Bollard of the Reform Party and was won by Lee Martin with a majority of just 175.

en.t: Last day of the Battle of Boquerón between Paraguay and Bolivia during the Chaco War
en.s: The Battle of Boquerón was fought September 9–29, 1932, between the Bolivian and Paraguayan armies in and around the stronghold of Boquerón. It was the first major battle of the Chaco War. The outpost (fortín) of Boquerón, among others, had been occupied by Bolivian troops since late July 1932 following instructions of president Daniel Salamanca, which led to the escalation of what began as a border conflict into a full-scale war.

zh.s: 博克龙战役于1932年9月9日至29日在博克龙据点及其周边地区进行，交战双方是巴拉圭和玻利维亚军队。这是查科战争的第一场主要战役。1932年7月底以来，玻利维亚军队已按总统丹尼尔·萨拉曼卡的指示占领包括博克龙在内的多个前哨据点，边境冲突因此升级为全面战争。

en.s: The Battle of Cape Spartel (Cabo Espartel in Spanish) was a naval battle of the Spanish Civil War that broke the Republican blockade of the Strait of Gibraltar, securing the maritime supply route to Spanish Morocco for the Nationalists early in the war. The action occurred on September 29, 1936 between two Nationalist cruisers and two Republican destroyers.

zh.s: 斯巴特尔角海战（西班牙语称卡波埃斯帕特尔海战）是西班牙内战期间的一场海战。国民军舰队打破了共和军对直布罗陀海峡的封锁，确保了战争初期通往西属摩洛哥的海上补给线。1936年9月29日，双方出动两艘国民军巡洋舰和两艘共和军驱逐舰交战。

en.s: On 29 September 1940, a mid-air collision occurred over Brocklesby, New South Wales, Australia. The accident was unusual in that the aircraft involved, two Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF) Avro Ansons of No. 2 Service Flying Training School, remained locked together after colliding, and then landed safely. The collision stopped the engines of the upper Anson, but those of the one underneath continued to run, allowing the aircraft to keep flying.

zh.t: 布罗克尔斯比空中相撞事故
zh.s: 1940年9月29日，两架澳大利亚皇家空军第2飞行训练学校的Avro Anson飞机在新南威尔士州布罗克尔斯比上空相撞。两架飞机相撞后卡在一起，却仍成功着陆，这种情况十分罕见。上方飞机的发动机停止运转，但下方飞机的发动机仍在工作，使两机得以继续飞行。

en.s: The 1941 United States Senate special election in Mississippi was held on September 29 to complete the unexpired term of Senator Pat Harrison. en.s: The Drama uprising (Greek: Εξέγερση της Δράμας; Bulgarian: Драмско въстание, romanized: Dramsko vastanie; Macedonian: Драмско востание) was an uprising of the population of the northern Greek city of Drama and the surrounding villages on 28–29 September 1941 against the Bulgarian occupation regime. zh.t: 第二次世界大战期间，德军在当地乌克兰合作者协助下开始为期两天的巴比亚尔大屠杀
zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，纳粹德国占领波兰和苏联乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国时，发生了乌克兰人与纳粹德国的合作。到1941年9月，德国占领的乌克兰领土被划分为两个新的德国行政区：纳粹德国总督府辖下的加利西亚区，以及乌克兰专员辖区。

en.s: Babi Yar (Russian: Бабий Яр) or Babyn Yar (Ukrainian: Бабин Яр) is a ravine in the Ukrainian capital Kyiv and a site of massacres carried out by Nazi Germany's forces during its campaign against the Soviet Union in World War II. The first and best documented of the massacres took place on 29–30 September 1941, in which some 33,771 Jews were murdered.

zh.s: 巴比亚尔（又称巴比恩亚尔）是乌克兰首都基辅的一处沟谷，也是纳粹德国在第二次世界大战侵略苏联期间实施屠杀的地点。首场有充分记录的大屠杀发生于1941年9月29日至30日，约33,771名犹太人遇害。

en.s: Operation Braganza was launched on the night of 29 September 1942 by Lieutenant-General Brian Horrocks, commanding British XIII Corps. It was intended as a preliminary to Operation Lightfoot, part of the Second Battle of El Alamein. The objective was to capture an area of ground near Deir el Munassib in Egypt, to be used for extra artillery deployment.

zh.s: 1942年9月29日夜间，英国第十三军团司令布赖恩·霍罗克斯中将发起布拉干萨行动。该行动是“轻足行动”的前期准备，属于第二次阿拉曼战役的一部分。英军的目标是夺取埃及代尔穆纳西卜附近的一片高地，以便部署更多火炮。

en.s: The Lookout Air Raids were two air raids carried out by the Empire of Japan in the Klamath Mountains of Oregon in September 1942. On September 9, 1942, a Japanese Yokosuka E14Y Glen floatplane, launched from a Japanese submarine, dropped two incendiary bombs with the intention of starting a forest fire. However, with the efforts of a patrol of fire lookouts and weather conditions not amenable to a fire, the damage done by the attack was minor.

en.s: The Battle of Arracourt took place between U.S. and German armoured forces near the town of Arracourt, Lorraine, France between 18 and 29 September 1944, during the Lorraine Campaign of World War II. As part of a counteroffensive against recent U.S. advances in France, the German 5th Panzer Army had as its objective the recapture of Lunéville and the elimination of the XII Corps bridgehead over the Moselle River at Dieulouard.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战洛林战役期间，1944年9月18日至29日，美军与德军装甲部队在法国洛林的阿拉库尔附近交战。德军第五装甲集团军发动反攻，目标是夺回吕内维尔，并消灭美军第十二军在迪耶洛阿尔附近跨过摩泽尔河建立的桥头堡。

en.s: The Battle of Jaktorów was a partisan battle fought on 29 September 1944 near the village of Budy Zosine close to Jaktorów, ending with the defeat of the main forces of the Kampinos Group by the Germans. After the outbreak of the Warsaw Uprising, the eastern and central areas of the Kampinos Forest became a base for a strong partisan group of the Home Army.

The final, unusually, was played on a Saturday. An inexperienced Down side, playing their first final, lost by twenty-three points. Dublin's Kathleen Cody, Sophie Brack and J. zh.t: 1948年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1948年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛是第17届全爱尔兰决赛，也是该届锦标赛的决胜场。这项卡莫吉赛事由爱尔兰顶级郡队参加。决赛罕见地安排在星期六举行。首次闯入决赛、经验不足的唐郡队以23分之差落败。都柏林队的凯瑟琳·科迪、索菲·布拉克和J.科斯格雷夫均上演帽子戏法。

en.s: The 1954 FA Charity Shield was the 32nd FA Charity Shield, a football match between the winners of the previous season's First Division and FA Cup titles. This year's match was contested by league champions Wolverhampton Wanderers and FA Cup winners West Bromwich Albion. The two Black Country rivals had been the main contenders for the league championship of the previous campaign, with Wolves edging out their challengers by four points in the end to claim their first ever league title.

en.s: WWJ-TV (channel 62), branded as CBS Detroit, is a television station in Detroit, Michigan, United States. en.t: 1976 Turks and Caicos Islands general election
en.s: General elections were held in the Turks and Caicos Islands on 29 September 1976. Although the Progressive National Organisation (PNO) received the most votes, the People's Democratic Movement (PDM) emerged as the largest party in the Legislative Council, winning five of the eleven seats. Following the elections, the PDM formed a coalition government with the two independents, with PDM leader James Alexander George Smith McCartney becoming the first Chief Minister of the islands.

zh.s: 特克斯和凯科斯群岛于1976年9月29日举行大选。进步民族组织（PNO）得票最多，但人民民主运动（PDM）在立法会中成为最大党，赢得11个席位中的5席。选举后，PDM与两名无党派议员组成联合政府，党魁詹姆斯·亚历山大·乔治·史密斯·麦卡特尼成为群岛首任首席部长。

en.t: Equatorial Guinean dictator Francisco Macías Nguema is executed by soldiers from Western Sahara
en.s: Francisco Macías Nguema (born Mez-m Ngueme, later Africanised to Masie Nguema Biyogo Ñegue Ndong; 1 January 1924 – 29 September 1979), often referred to as Macías Nguema or simply Macías, was an Equatoguinean politician who served as the first president of Equatorial Guinea from the country's gaining of independence in 1968, until his overthrow in 1979. zh.s: 弗朗西斯科·马西亚斯·恩圭马（原名梅兹姆·恩圭梅，后改用非洲化姓名马西埃·恩圭马·比约戈·涅格·恩东；1924年1月1日—1979年9月29日），常称马西亚斯·恩圭马或马西亚斯，是赤道几内亚政治人物。该国1968年独立后，他出任首任总统，直到1979年被推翻。他被广泛视为历史上最残暴的独裁者之一。

en.t: On 29 September 1980, the 16th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 5th National People's Congress adopted the Decision on Establishing the Special Procuratorate of the Supreme People's Procuratorate and the Special Court of the Supreme People's Court to Prosecute and Try the Principal Offenders in the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-Revolutionary Clique Case
en.s: The Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-Revolutionary Cliques was a criminal case in China after the end of the Cultural Revolution. The name of this case referred to two “counter-revolutionary” groups or “cliques” headed by Lin Biao and Jiang Qing, respectively, who "wanted to seize supreme power".

en.s: The Mike Marino Memorial Shield was a British professional wrestling single-elimination tournament produced by Dale Martin Promotions, which took place on 29 September 1981 at Fairfield Halls in Croydon, England. The event aired on ITV's World of Sport two months later. One of the first, if not the first, memorial shows in British professional wrestling, it was held in memory of longtime British Mid-Heavyweight Champion Mike Marino, arguably the most popular pro wrestler in the country during the 1960s and 70s, who died on the M20 motorway in Folkestone, Kent on 24 August 1981.

zh.t: 迈克·马里诺纪念盾牌赛
zh.s: 迈克·马里诺纪念盾牌赛是由戴尔·马丁推广公司举办的英国职业摔角单败淘汰赛，于1981年9月29日在英格兰克罗伊登的费尔菲尔德音乐厅举行。赛事两个月后在ITV《体育世界》节目中播出。这是英国职业摔角界最早的纪念赛之一，旨在纪念迈克·马里诺。他曾长期担任英国中重量级冠军，被认为是20世纪60至70年代英国最受欢迎的摔角手之一，1981年8月24日在肯特郡福克斯通的M20高速公路上遇难。

en.s: On 29 September 1981, an Iranian Air Force C-130 military cargo aircraft crashed into a firing range near Kahrizak, Iran. The plane was flying from Ahvaz, Khuzestan province to Tehran, while returning from an inspection tour of Iranian military gains in the Iran–Iraq War. The crashed killed 80 people, including former Defence Minister Javad Fakoori, then-Defence Minister Mousa Namjoo, then-Chief-of-Staff of the Army Valiollah Fallahi, and then-commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Mohammad Jahanara.

zh.s: 1981年9月29日，伊朗空军一架C-130军用运输机在伊朗卡赫里扎克附近坠入射击场。飞机从胡齐斯坦省阿瓦士飞往德黑兰，当时机上人员刚结束对两伊战争中伊朗军队战果的视察。空难造成80人死亡，其中包括前国防部长贾瓦德·法库里、时任国防部长穆萨·纳姆朱、时任陆军参谋长瓦利奥拉·法拉希和时任伊斯兰革命卫队指挥官穆罕默德·贾哈纳拉。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in Louisiana
en.s: The primary election for the 1984 United States Senate election in Louisiana was held on September 29, 1984. Incumbent Democratic Senator J. Bennett Johnston won the election with 85% of the vote and was declared elected by a majority, dispelling the need for a general election in November. This was despite Republican president Ronald Reagan carrying the state with more than 60% of the vote in the concurrent presidential election.

It was conducted under the one member, one vote universal suffrage system, making the Parti Québécois the first political party to do so in Quebec history.

en.s: STS-26 was the 26th NASA Space Shuttle mission and the seventh flight of the orbiter Discovery. The mission launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on September 29, 1988, and landed four days later on October 3, 1988. STS-26 was declared the "Return to Flight" mission, being the first mission after the Space Shuttle Challenger disaster of January 28, 1986.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Gambia on 29 September 1996. The first since the 1994 military coup led by Yahya Jammeh, they were also the first elections to be held under the new constitution, and the first presidential elections held separately from parliamentary elections. Voter turnout was exceptionally high, with 88% of the 446,541 registered voters voting. Despite originally stating that he did not intend to run, Jammeh entered the race shortly before the elections. He emerged victorious with 55.8% of the vote, winning the most votes in every district except Mansa Konko (where UDP candidate Ousainou Darboe was the most voted-for).

zh.s: 冈比亚于1996年9月29日举行总统选举。这是1994年叶海亚·贾梅发动军事政变后举行的首次选举，也是新宪法生效后的首次选举；总统选举也首次与议会选举分开举行。登记选民共446,541人，投票率高达88%。贾梅原本表示不会参选，但在投票前不久改变主意。他最终以55.8%的得票率获胜，除曼萨孔科选区的票数最多者为民主与发展组织候选人乌赛努·达尔博外，贾梅在其他所有选区都得票最多。

en.s: 4179 Toutatis (provisional designation 1989 AC) is an elongated, stony asteroid and slow rotator, classified as a near-Earth object and potentially hazardous asteroid of the Apollo asteroid group, approximately 2.5 kilometers in diameter. en.t: Violence and low turnout mar the 2019 Afghan presidential election
en.s: Presidential elections were held in Afghanistan on 28 September 2019. According to preliminary results, which runner-up Abdullah Abdullah appealed against, incumbent Ashraf Ghani was re-elected with 923,592 votes, 50.64% of the vote. After delays over disputed votes, Ghani was declared the winner in the final results on 18 February 2020. Abdullah Abdullah rejected the results and moved to set up his own parallel government and separate inauguration.

en.s: The 2020 United States presidential debates were a series of debates held during the 2020 presidential election. The Commission on Presidential Debates (CPD), a bipartisan organization formed in 1987, organized three debates among the major party candidates, and sponsored two presidential debates and one vice presidential debate. Only Republican nominee Donald Trump and Democratic nominee Joe Biden met the criteria for inclusion in the debates, and thus were the only two to appear in the debates.

en.s: The 2021 Campeones Cup was the third edition of the Campeones Cup, an annual North American football match contested between the champions of the previous Major League Soccer season and the winner of the Campeón de Campeones from Liga MX. en.s: Legislative elections were held in Austria on 29 September 2024 to elect the 28th National Council, the lower house of Austria's bicameral parliament. The election saw the far-right Freedom Party of Austria (FPÖ) place first, winning 28.8% of the vote and achieving the best result in the party's history. This was the first time that a far-right party won the most seats in a legislative election in Austria after World War II.
